method: One warmup and 3 rotating serial release samples. Complete retained model plus every-value/coordinate verification inside each native worker; import/build/generation excluded. Identical worker source/lockfile/toolchain, prior core b5990868623e31b8cc3e47f4ba3bf0f906e54865 versus candidate; hashes identify binaries. Calamine returns retained noneditable text ranges; CrabXL retains editable models plus source catalogs.
resource_settings: CrabXL 1 GiB joint/model allowances, 256 MiB SST allowance, 1 MiB decoded disk cache; explicit RAM/disk policy. These are managed allowances, not an RSS limit. Calamine uses its defaults.
decision: Rejected: owned text model increases RSS and changes public Rust representation; runtime implementation reverted.
